subject: Galvanised trailer supply for Wide Bay Trailers: 30-minute meeting?
body:
Hi Wide Bay Trailers team,

I noticed Wide Bay Trailers sources globally and assembles here in Queensland. That's exactly how we supply dealers, so I thought it was worth a conversation.

I'm with Innovatix. We're a steel fabrication company with our own factory in India, and we build fully hot-dip galvanised trailers that ship flat-packed to Australian dealers. Several Queensland dealers already stock our range, and the response has been very strong.

Here's why dealers are moving their imported range to us:
- Higher-grade, certified steel: we supply mill certificates and welder certifications so you can check it yourself
- Fully hot-dip galvanised
- ADR-approved drawbars and CTA-approved couplings for trailers up to 3500 kg, with VINs supplied if you need them
- Factory-direct pricing, landed below comparable Chinese imports
- Flexible credit terms: you can pay as the trailers sell
- Mixed containers: different trailers in one load, plus extra parts if you build or repair locally
- A trial container or sample unit, so you can test us without the risk
- Dependable lead times straight from our own factory, with no trader in the middle
- Our own proven designs, or custom features to make yours unique, depending on volume

I've attached a short range proposal built around the 8x5 tipping cage trailers, ATV trailers and tandems you already sell, with photos of recent builds from our factory.

Could we find 30 minutes in the next couple of weeks? I'm happy to meet in person in Gin Gin and bring a weld cut-section and our mill certificates so you can see the build quality first-hand. Would Tuesday 1 or Thursday 3 December work, or is there a better time for you?

Kind regards,
